//: Points at the local `supabase start` stack. Every value below is a fixed, published default of that stack — it is the same on every machine and grants nothing beyond a container on this one. Do not put hosted-project values in this file.

ConnectionStrings.//: Port 54322 is the local database (54321 is the API gateway). See supabase/config.toml.

Supabase.//JwtSecret: Deliberately unset. The local stack now signs with rotating ES256 keys published at /auth/v1/.well-known/jwks.json, same as a hosted project, so tokens are verified the same way in both places. Setting this switches verification to the legacy shared HS256 secret and every current token fails as a bad signature — only set it against a stack old enough to still issue HS256.

Cors.//: Not needed with the Vite proxy, but harmless, and it saves an afternoon when someone runs the two servers apart.
